setup.js: (()=>{window.__avisos=[];const re=/N[ãa]o foi poss[ií]vel|Erro ao|Tente novamente|Algo deu errado|Falha ao|Something went wrong|inv[áa]lid/i;const chk=(t)=>{t=(t||'').trim();const m=t&&t.match(new RegExp('[^]{0,40}('+re.source+')[^]{0,40}','i'));if(m&&window.__avisos.length<10)window.__avisos.push(m[0].replace(/[\n\r\t ]+/g,' '))};new MutationObserver(ms=>{for(const m of ms){m.addedNodes.forEach(n=>chk(n.textContent));if(m.type==='characterData')chk(m.target.textContent)}}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});chk(document.body.innerText);setInterval(()=>{document.querySelectorAll('[data-sonner-toast][data-type=error]').forEach(t=>{const s='TOAST DE ERRO: '+t.textContent.trim().slice(0,90);if(!window.__avisos.includes(s)&&window.__avisos.length<10)window.__avisos.push(s)})},300);return 1})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const norm=t=>t.replace(/[\s\u00a0]+/g,' ').toLowerCase();const esp=["Frete das entregas de outubro", "Venda de sacos de ráfia usados", "R$ 450,00", "R$ 120,00"];let out='';for(let i=0;i<20;i++){const els=[...document.querySelectorAll("main section[aria-label='Detalhes de Cooperativa Recome\u00e7o']")];const el=false?els[els.length-1]:els[0];if(!el){out='DIFERENTE: sem elemento';}else{const t=norm(el.innerText);const falta=esp.filter(e=>!t.includes(norm(e)));if(!falta.length)return 'OK: '+esp.join(' | ');out='DIFERENTE: faltou '+JSON.stringify(falta)+' em: '+t.slice(0,240);}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));}return out})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const s=document.querySelector("[aria-label='Seções da ficha']");if(!s)return 'SEM ALVO';const x0=s.scrollLeft,dx=(s.scrollWidth-s.clientWidth)-x0;if(Math.abs(dx)<3)return 'ok';await new Promise(res=>{const t0=performance.now();const f=t=>{const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/500),e=p<.5?2*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,2)/2;s.scrollLeft=x0+dx*e;p<1?requestAnimationFrame(f):res()};requestAnimationFrame(f)});return 'faixa:'+Math.round(s.scrollLeft)})()
